run_wiki_auto_main: run the WikiAuto dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_wiki_auto_instance: create a WikiAuto classification dataset instance with aligned and notAligned label mappings
load_wiki_auto_dataset: load the wiki_auto HuggingFace dataset using the manual configuration split
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of sentence pairs with alignment labels
get_train_test_lines: get training and test line pairs from the WikiAuto dataset using train and dev splits
